# 2026-10-07 — Pilot Review

> Status: reviewed. Participants: Maya, Jo, Eli, and desk volunteers.

## Evidence and observations

The day-five reminder batch has not produced enough evidence for a causal claim. Volunteers report that reading the written due date aloud is repeatable. Six of seven volunteers have completed the updated check-in walkthrough; the seventh needs a supervised shift.

## Decisions

Keep the posted seven-day term and one day-five reminder for the next cycle, without adding an automatic second message. Record this as [D-04](../decisions.md#decision-log). The [borrowing policy](../kb/borrowing-policy.md) remains the current view.

## Actions

Eli closes the [10 October snapshot](../kb/pilot-metrics.md#10-october-snapshot). Maya schedules the remaining walkthrough [A-05](../actions.md#open-actions). Cross-branch returns remain blocked pending a policy owner.
